# Local REST API with MCP

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Support automation for notes using REST API for apps or MCP server for AI agents.

## Scope note

- Enable Obsidian functions for Claude Desktop or Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients such as Python services, scripts, or agents.
- Create, read, update, or delete notes.
- Patch specific sections of notes by heading, block, or frontmatter properties.
- Search you vault using full-text or JsonLogic queries against note metadata (frontmatter, tags, path, or content).
- Access the active Obsidian file.
- List and execute commands.
- Query tags.
- Open files in Obsidian user interface.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Plugin](../ObsidianPlugin/)
